name: godogen
description: Godogen: describe a game and a coding agent builds it. LOKI writes godogen's game-building instructions (runtime process, a one-page engine guide for Godot GDScript/C#, Bevy, Babylon.js or three.js, and the asset-gen skill) into ~/LOKI Projects/<name>, then Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, Nanocoder or LOKI's own agent builds, runs and checks the game there as a background job you approve (the make_godot_game tool). Paid asset APIs are only used after you say yes.
license: MIT (godogen's text in contrib/godogen, Copyright 2026 Alex Ermolov)
notice: Godot 4 on PATH (or GODOT_BIN) to run the games; local asset generation needs godogen_assets on an NVIDIA GPU (set LOKI_GODOGEN_ASSETS), otherwise assets come from paid APIs only after you agree.
